newsitem.title: INDONESIA: United Tractors says plans rights issue.
newsitem.headline: United Tractors says plans rights issue.

text.p: Indonesia's PT United Tractors said on Tuesday it was planning a three-billion-rupiah rights issue by the first half of next year.

"We expect to have a three billion rupiah rights issue between the second half of this year and the first half of next year," Tractors vice president-director M.A. Imanto told Reuters after attending a conference organised by ING Baring Securities.
He said proceeds from the rights issue would be used to finance the company's expansion. He gave no further details on the rights issue.
Imanto said car maker Astra International was expected to keep its 49 percent stake in Tractors.
Astra had recently lowered its Tractors' stake to 49 percent from 53 percent.
